title: potentilla polyphylla var. interrupta
intro: Potentilla polyphylla var. interrupta, commonly known as Tashiro's cinquefoil, is a plant species native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral agent, making it effective in treating various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla polyphylla var. interrupta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
